author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**


GO:0035615 | clathrin adaptor activity | IBA with PTN000045135 , MGI:1352504


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC688.11
end4 and other family members


* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

Clathrin  adaptor is defined

Bringing together a cargo protein with clathrin, responsible for the formation of endocytic vesicles.

end4/sla2 etc aren't technically  cargo adaptors, they link the clathrin coat  tothe actin cytoskeleton
but dont  directly recognize specific sorting signals on cargo proteins and recruit them into clathrin-coated vesicles. 

I'm going to request that "GO:0035615 | clathrin adaptor activity  is renamed to 
GO:0035615 | clathrin cargo adaptor activity 


* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).

body: So I would say the term sounds good, but does not correspond to the definition. It is great to make the changes at the GO term level, but what will be the right term in this case, 'adaptor activity' ? @pgaudet ?

body: My bad... we have primary annotations GO:0030674 - 'protein-macromolecule adaptor activity', so I could make the change.
